summary: Olema Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to announce a clinical trial collaboration with Bayer. The collaboration involves a Phase 1b/2 study of OP-3136 combined with darolutamide for mCRPC, starting H2 2026. Bayer supplies darolutamide; Olema leads the study. No financial terms, equity, or change of control are involved. This is a routine R&D collaboration disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for trial enrollment updates.
